simple.meaning: חֲבַצֶּלֶת (chăbatstseleth) is a Hebrew word meaning “probably meadow-saffron.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֲבַצֶּלֶת (H2261) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 2:1, with occurrences in Song of Solomon, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲבַצֶּלֶת (H2261) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֲבַצֶּלֶת (H2261) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֲבַצֶּלֶת (chăbatstseleth) / H2261 is traced through Song of Songs 2:1, Isaiah 35:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
